summary: Optional cache persistence must not replace a successfully validated Rakuten result with a command failure.
reason: Cache directories can be unwritable or invalid independently of upstream correctness. Preserve successfully parsed results, report each failed save only through an optional diagnostic callback, and keep source/network/parse failures as errors.
validated_outcome: Deterministic ENOTDIR tests cover all four APIs, both Hotel pages, nil and warning callbacks, NoCache/default-live inventory suppression, and preservation of genuine source failures.
